Design document and pitch

Focus Deck

An installable app that hands you one task at a time, for people with too many tasks and too little energy to choose.

Every screenshot on this page is the real app, not a mockup, shot with 8 projects, 56 tasks and 5 thoughts.

Design pillars

One thing at a time

The main screen never shows the backlog. It shows a single task and the action to finish it.

Choosing costs nothing

You pick a kind of work or a project, and the app picks the task at random.

A desk, not a database

Sticky notes, a clipboard, a filing cabinet and a rubber stamp make each screen feel like a physical object.

The core loop

A thought becomes a task, the task gets filed and ordered, and then the app hands it back one at a time. The six tabs follow that order.

  1. JotType a stray thought in the top bar, from any tab.
  2. SortFile one thought at a time: project, priority, labels, due date.
  3. OrganizeTidy up duplicates and triage a long list.
  4. RoadmapSee a project's milestones in four columns.
  5. FocusGet one task. Press Done, or "Not now".
  6. ReviewCheck what is waiting and close it.

Screens

Phone, and dark mode

Look and feel

Four shapes carry the whole interface. The rule from docs/4-systems/desk-layout.md: the biggest note on a screen is the thing to do next.

Yellow sticky note
A task. The biggest one is the one to do next.
Small coloured note
The next step of one area or project, in the area's colour.
RUBBER STAMP
The main action. One per screen.
Plain button
Everything else, always with a word on it.

Navigation is ring-binder divider tabs: a bar along the bottom on a phone, a column on the left from 1100px wide. Light and dark themes both ship.

Systems

SystemWhat it owns
Focus pickerChoosing one task: project, kind of work, "Choosing a card" setting
Sort and in-trayJotted thoughts and the nine-step filing flow
RoadmapSections, milestones, four columns, next step
Due datesWhite, yellow and red deadline stages
Local storageState in the browser, backups, multi-tab safety
GitHub syncTasks as GitHub issues, optional
Gist syncMerging state across devices, with deletion tombstones
PWA shellInstall, offline caching

The full list of 25 system documents is in docs/4-systems/README.md.

Risks and open questions

GitHub issue sync has two reported bugs (#93 and #94).

Documents are older than the code

Not a game

Focus Deck has no game mechanics. This page borrows the game design document layout only.
